reason: Publish BatikCraft Studio 0.9.19. Fixes the eraser on the main raster canvas refusing to remove lines. Lines became raster in 0.9.17 but were stored as separate stroke objects floating above the canvas, while the eraser on a raster paint layer only clears that layer's own bitmap, so a line drawn on the main canvas looked immune to the eraser. A line drawn while a raster canvas layer is active is now merged into that layer's bitmap, exactly like a brush stroke, and the eraser removes it. Lines drawn on object layers keep behaving as stroke objects. Verified by checking that pixel alpha under the line drops to zero after erasing, rather than assuming it.
